ProjectWeave request for the selected Task (data):
{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVQjccM8AAAABZlZQAg", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn3IfzhDL7X8", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn3If", "number": 85, "title": "Correct V30MZ MUL/IMUL timing without double-counting operand transfers", "body": "## Problem

At baseline `07b1d1f17ff32dabc6295206dda1d9fe026bb479`, `crates/ws-core/src/cpu.rs:966` charges immediate IMUL 12 residual clocks; line 1181 charges byte/word MUL and IMUL 12/20. `cpu/multiply_tests.rs` preserves these excessive charges. Multiplication therefore advances timers, raster and audio too far relative to executed software across all three models.

Calculated internal-register examples are `F6 E3`: 14→5 clocks, `F7 EB`: 22→5, and `6B DB FE`: 15→6. These are source-derived totals, not executed observations. Commercial-title impact remains unmeasured.

## Expected outcome

Correct timing for all six documented forms: byte/word unsigned MUL, byte/word signed IMUL, immediate-word IMUL (`69`) and sign-extended immediate-byte IMUL (`6B`). Preserve products, complete FLAGS, operand sampling, multiplication history and continuation. Include necessary cross-file regression coverage, an original timing probe, native/browser consumers and documentation.

## Context

The clean checkout and inspected remote main match the baseline. No open Issues or PRs exist; all 84 closed entry titles were checked without finding equivalent completed timing work.

The [NEC V30MZ preliminary manual](https://www.renesas.com/en/document/lbr/v30mztm-hardware-preliminary), Appendix A, printed pp. 73/79, gives three decoded clocks for register multiplication, including immediate forms, and four for memory sources. Its conditions include completed decoding, aligned words, no waits/holds and qualified addressing. Subtracting the already charged aligned operand read implies a three-clock residual for every form; actual fetches, transfers and waits remain separately charged once. This is an explicit inference for the existing serialized scheduler.

Correction record: the old AI-authored assumption preserved residuals 12/20, including 12 for immediate forms. Replace it with the accounting above, using the manual and current bus implementation as rationale. [Issue #43](https://github.com/takahirox/wonderswan-rust/issues/43) deferred absolute timing; preserve its architectural requirements and [Issue #65](https://github.com/takahirox/wonderswan-rust/issues/65) multiplication-history behavior. Record further primary-evidence corrections with the old assumption, corrected requirement, source and rationale; no human approval or independent AI re-review is required.

Full prefetch/pipeline fidelity, effective-address hazards, division timing and unrelated bus corrections remain separate gaps. The inspected [WSTimingTest report](https://github.com/FluBBaOfWard/WSTimingTest/blob/025e606fc3b6615160ffdae485d992ffcad0c024/README.md) explains why aggregate loop measurements cannot be transplanted as isolated instruction costs.

[PR #84](https://github.com/takahirox/wonderswan-rust/pull/84) and [saved #83 validation](https://github.com/takahirox/wonderswan-rust/blob/07b1d1f17ff32dabc6295206dda1d9fe026bb479/docs/issue-83-validation.md) report 299 workspace tests, complete production Chromium suites and criterion-level Coordinator review passing. Relevant tests and probe tooling are present; no builds or application tests were run during this investigation.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] Before changing charges, record independent literal timing/state vectors and demonstrate actual baseline failures followed by corrected passes. At even internal-RAM instruction addresses, require five clocks for register F6/F7 multiplication and six for register `69`/`6B`. Unprefixed `[BX]` byte/aligned-word F6/F7 requires six; odd words require seven. Derive additional expectations without production timing helpers.
- [ ] Cover all six forms, fit/overflow, zero, signed boundaries, both immediate widths and `6B` sign extension. Preserve independent product/full-FLAGS vectors under contrasting incoming flags, model-dependent unsigned ZF, AL/AH/AX/DX aliases, immediate source/destination aliases, untouched state/memory, exact IP and actual following instructions. Preserve history production, replacement, survival across independent FLAGS changes, subsequent byte DIV and lifecycle handling from #65.
- [ ] Assert exact fetch/operand accounting for registers and mapped RAM/SRAM/ROM sources, aligned/odd words, DS/SS defaults, overrides, displacements, instruction/operand offset wrapping, bank/20-bit boundaries and RAM availability. Cover mapped fetches, live A0 `00/04/08/0C`, existing SRAM waits and up to seven mixed segment/BUSLOCK prefixes. Preserve REP diagnostics. Memory-source multiplication must neither write its source nor duplicate reads.
- [ ] Exercise emulated Mono/Color/SwanCrystal model configurations: Mono `00`; Color and SwanCrystal `00/80/C0/E0`, including live returns to `00`. Through normal `Machine::run_frame`, verify representative forms crossing raster/frame boundaries with exact elapsed clocks, timer/frame/raster progression, stereo sample production and no extra continuation instruction. Preserve IF shadows, TF/IRQ delivery with separate entry charges, REP/HALT and capability-gated GDMA/SDMA reservations.
- [ ] Add an original source-included CC0 timing cartridge using existing fixture tooling and independent native and production Chromium/Wasm consumers. Cover every form with representative register and memory sources. Independently derive absolute timer bounds; compare CPU-written products/full FLAGS, execution counts, continuation and fresh completion. Initialize operands per repetition where needed to avoid degenerate repeated products. Re-poison retained observations before each of two boots. Run identical final probe bytes with former and corrected charges in both consumers; collect timing failures across all model/mode passes and both boots so an early rejection cannot conceal later samples.
- [ ] Audit existing measured intervals for multiplication and recalculate only affected budgets from instruction bytes and independent arithmetic. Preserve unrelated assertions, historical reports and existing fixture/demo bytes; do not widen tolerances to accommodate failures. Retain prior shift/control-flow/IRQ acceptance, firmware-free startup, model gates, LCD/input/frame continuity, audio/PCM, DMA/Hyper Voice, SRAM, both EEPROM controllers, RTC, browser save integrity and ownership/provenance.
- [ ] Before merge, Coordinator runs and records `python3 fixtures/build.py --check`, `python3 demo/build.py --check`, `cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `cargo test --workspace --locked`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `git diff --check`. In `web`, run `npm run build:wasm` and `npm run build`, then complete `npm run test:browser` and `npm run test:compat` sequentially against that production build, including the new consumer.
- [ ] Update `docs/hardware-subset.md`, multiplication accounting rationale, fixture provenance and validation evidence. Coordinator reviews every checkbox against the final diff and resolves blocking findings before merge. Record tested source/artifact identities, actual observations, failures, resolutions, skipped checks and remaining uncertainty; distinguish tests present from checks reported passing. Preserve acceptance when correcting technical assumptions.

## Optional validation

Additional independent vectors, other browser engines and lawful software workloads. Physical-console measurements and human gameplay are optional and unperformed here. Proprietary ROMs/firmware, device identities and human sign-off are unnecessary for mandatory acceptance. Original-probe success establishes bounded behavior, not commercial-catalog readiness.

## Required post-merge verification

None.

## Specification reconciliation

This task was authored by AI under the agreed WonderSwan-family hardware goal.
Correct erroneous technical assumptions or acceptance criteria when primary hardware
specifications establish the correction. Update this Issue and record the original
assumption, corrected requirement, primary reference and rationale in the PR.
These technical corrections require neither human approval nor an independent AI
re-review. Preserve the agreed goal and relevant pre-merge acceptance; do not weaken
requirements merely to accommodate incomplete implementation or failing tests.

This autonomous campaign has no human-approval gate. Mandatory acceptance uses
automated native and production-browser tests on the emulator's supported model
and mode configurations. Physical-console measurements and human gameplay are
optional evidence and must remain explicitly unperformed unless actually available.
Do not invent device identities, real-device results or a requirement for human
confirmation. Resolve technical errors with recorded evidence and automated checks
through the existing Coordinator workflow.
